# Phase 6: Website

**Built and in this repo:** [`site/`](../site/): 13 pages × 2 languages, generated by `node site/build.mjs` into `site/dist/` (pure static HTML/CSS/JS; ~70 KB per page before fonts).
- Final copy for every page, FR and EN: [`site/src/content.mjs`](../site/src/content.mjs)
- Business facts in one place: [`site/src/config.mjs`](../site/src/config.mjs)
- Design tokens: [`site/src/styles.css`](../site/src/styles.css)

## 1. Strategy

| Goal | Main conversion | Measured by (GA4 event via GTM) |
|---|---|---|
| Fill weekend brunch without queues | Book a table | `click_book`, `click_book_nav` → reservation provider conversion |
| Grow commission-free takeout | Order online | `click_order` → POS online-order purchase |
| Win catering accounts | Quote request | `mailto` clicks on catering page (`click_catering_quote`) |
| Drive visits | Directions / call | `click_directions`, `click_call` |
| Build the owned audience | Newsletter | `newsletter_signup` |

**User journeys**
- **Camille (hybrid worker):** Google "café wifi {quartier}" → Home (open-now badge, "Toute la journée") → Menu (latte prices) → Directions. *Needs:* hours, Wi-Fi FAQ, laptop policy.
- **Karim (brunch group):** Instagram Reel → link in bio → Home → **Réserver** → reservation provider. *Needs:* booking in 2 taps, vegan and halal filters on the menu.
- **Sophie (office organiser):** Google "traiteur bureau montréal" → Catering page → quote email. *Needs:* allergen labelling, invoice/PO, delivery time.

## 3. Page wireframes (implemented)

| Page | Blocks, top to bottom |
|---|---|
| Home | Sticky header (logo, nav, **Réserver** button, language switch) → Hero (eyebrow, H1, lead, 3 CTAs, live "Ouvert maintenant" badge, shakshuka-and-sun illustration; swap for a hero photo after the shoot) → 3 pillars → 6 signature cards → Catering teaser + NAP + hours → Footer (NAP, hours, social, newsletter with CASL consent, legal links) |
| Menu | H1 + ordering note → sticky tools (search, diet chips, allergen filter, category chips) → categories → legal notes |
| Order / Book / Gift | H1, lead with the benefit, provider button (shows "Bientôt disponible" until configured), phone fallback, reassurance checklist |
| Our story | Long story (Phase 1 §8), handwritten sign-off |
| Catering | Promise → price list from the master menu → 3-step process → quote CTA → private events |
| FAQ | 12 accordions (FAQPage schema) |
| Contact | NAP, directions/call buttons, transit, accessibility, hours, map link |
| Careers | Benefits checklist, application mailto |
| Privacy / Terms | Law 25-compliant privacy policy; terms for orders, bookings, gift cards, loyalty, allergies |

## 4. SEO by page

| Page (FR / EN) | Title tag | Primary keywords | H1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Home | Miam's Resto Café \| Café & brunch méditerranéen à Montréal / …Mediterranean café & brunch in Montréal | brunch montréal, café {quartier}, brunch méditerranéen | Café sérieux, cuisine méditerranéenne maison, toute la journée. |
| Menu | Menu \| Brunch, café, bols & mezzes | shakshuka montréal, brunch végane montréal, brunch halal montréal | Le menu / The menu |
| Order | Commander en ligne \| Pour emporter | commander brunch en ligne, café pour emporter {quartier} | Commander en ligne |
| Book | Réserver le brunch | réserver brunch montréal, brunch réservation | Réservez votre table |
| Our story | Notre histoire | café familial montréal | Notre histoire |
| Catering | Traiteur bureau Montréal \| Boîtes déjeuner & plateaux | traiteur bureau montréal, boîte à lunch entreprise, office catering montreal | Nourrir le bureau, sans stress. |
| FAQ, Contact, Gift, Reviews, Careers, Legal | See `content.mjs` | long-tail and brand | n/a |

All meta descriptions (≤ 155 characters, with benefit + CTA) are in `content.mjs`. **H2 structure** follows the sections listed in §3. **Image alt text rule** (for photos added after the shoot): `{dish name}: {2–4 visual words}, Miam's Resto Café Montréal`, e.g. `Shakshuka Miam's : œufs pochés dans la sauce tomate, poêle en fonte, Miam's Resto Café Montréal`. File names: `shakshuka-miams-montreal.webp` (the master DB `photo` field holds `{id}.jpg`; the build can rename on export).

## 5. Technical (implemented)

- **Schema.org JSON-LD:** `Restaurant` + `CafeOrCoffeeShop` (home, contact, menu), `Menu` with `MenuSection`/`MenuItem`/`Offer` and `suitableForDiet` (menu), `FAQPage` (FAQ), `BreadcrumbList` (all inner pages). Validate at validator.schema.org and Google Rich Results Test after deploy.
- **hreflang:** each page declares `fr-CA`, `en-CA` and `x-default` (French); the sitemap carries the same alternates.
- **sitemap.xml, robots.txt** (disallows `/screens/`), 404 page, web manifest, security headers (`_headers`).
- **Core Web Vitals checklist:** ☐ LCP < 2.5 s (target 1.8) ☐ INP < 200 ms ☐ CLS < 0.1 ☐ fonts `display=swap` + preconnect ☐ images WebP, sized, lazy below the fold ☐ no third-party scripts before consent.
- **Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA):** skip link, landmark roles, visible focus rings (Faïence blue), contrast pairs from Phase 2, `aria-pressed` on filter chips, `aria-label` on inputs, `lang` on the page and the language link, reduced-motion respected, tap targets ≥ 44 px.
- **Law 25 consent:** Google Tag Manager is only injected after "Accepter"; nothing is tracked by default. The banner appears only when `gtmId` is set.

## 6. Integrations

| Need | Recommendation | Why | Cost (verify) | How it plugs in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commission-free online ordering | **The chosen POS's own online ordering** (Phase 9: e.g. Lightspeed Order Anywhere, Square Online, or the equivalent for the certified POS) | Orders land in the POS and KDS; sales recorded in the certified SRS system | Usually included or $0–80/mo + card fees | `orderUrl` in `config.mjs` |
| Reservations | **Libro** (Canadian, widely used in Montréal, Google Reserve integration) or the POS's module | Local support, Reserve with Google, SMS waitlist | Plans from ~$0–200/mo, verify | `reserveUrl` |
| Google Maps | Link card (no embed, so no third-party cookies before consent) | Law 25, speed | $0 | `mapsUrl` |
| Instagram feed | **Not embedded** (slow, and privacy issues); a "Suivez-nous" link instead | Speed | $0 | footer |
| Newsletter | Klaviyo or Mailchimp, double opt-in, CASL consent text already in the form | Consent proof, segmentation | $0–45/mo at launch | `newsletterAction` |
| Meta Pixel + CAPI, GA4 | Via GTM after consent; server-side CAPI through the POS/ordering platform if supported | Measure ROAS (Phase 11) | $0 | `gtmId` |
| Gift cards | POS e-gift cards | One balance system in-store and online | Usually included | `giftCardUrl` |

## 7. Platform recommendation

| Option | Monthly | Pros | Cons |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Custom static (built here) on Cloudflare Pages or Netlify** ⭐ | $0 hosting + ~$25/yr domain | Fastest possible, full SEO control, our schema, no plugins to patch, menu from the master database | Copy edits require a developer or Git (mitigated: MIAM OS Menu Manager later writes `menu.json`) |
| WordPress | $15–50 hosting + plugins | Easy editing | Plugin upkeep, slower, security patches |
| Wix / Squarespace | $25–50 | Drag-and-drop | Weaker hreflang/schema control; duplicate menu |
| Webflow | $25–45 | Designer-friendly CMS | Localization add-on cost; duplicate menu |

**Recommendation: keep the custom static site.** Deploy: ⚠️ OWNER ACTION: buy `miamsrestocafe.ca` (and `.com`) in the owner's name → create a Cloudflare account (owner is the account holder) → connect this GitHub repo → build command `node tools/build-menu.mjs && node site/build.mjs`, output `site/dist`.

## 8. Launch QA checklist

- [ ] Replace every `{PLACEHOLDER}` in `site/src/config.mjs` and `[bracket]` in `content.mjs` (grep for `{` and `[`)
- [ ] Real photos added; `og.png` replaced with a hero photo version
- [ ] All links clicked on mobile (iOS Safari, Android Chrome) in FR and EN
- [ ] Order and booking flows tested end-to-end with a real $1 order and a test booking
- [ ] Rich Results Test passes for Restaurant, Menu, FAQ
- [ ] Search Console + Bing Webmaster verified, sitemap submitted
- [ ] PageSpeed mobile ≥ 90 on Home and Menu
- [ ] Consent banner: nothing fires before Accept (check in DevTools → Network)
- [ ] Newsletter double opt-in email received, in French first
- [ ] 404 page, `/m/table` redirect, and language router tested
- [ ] Privacy officer name filled in; policy reviewed by counsel
- [ ] Hours match the Google Business Profile exactly
